non_blocking_notes: Frozen dataclass with immutable signals tuple and default warn-only recommendations confirmed
Comprehensive revalidation of untrusted observations at function entry including trust/mode/action authority boundaries
Deterministic confidence calculation: HIGH (2+ threat signals or threat+DMARC_FAIL), MEDIUM (threat or 2+ auth failures), LOW (single auth failure)
Evidence-first design: audit called before finding returned; evidence write failure raises EVIDENCE_WRITE_FAILED exception denying finding
Email-specific auth handling enforced: EMAIL_FIXTURE requires all auth keys, BROWSER_FIXTURE requires auth null/empty
Signal classification exact: BEC_DISPLAY_NAME, LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN, PHISHING_DOMAIN, QR_PHISHING, REDIRECT_CHAIN for threats; SPF_FAIL, DKIM_FAIL, DMARC_FAIL for auth
Sorted signals tuple ensures deterministic ordering; audit log includes response_executed=False and deployment=DISABLED
No mailbox, message movement, link-blocking, account, network, credential, filesystem, browser, or deployment operations present

result.reasoning_summary: FW-BME-02 deterministic phishing and spoof classification passes all deterministic checks and security constraints. The classify_phishing_spoof function and BrowserEmailFinding dataclass implement evidence-first, warn-only evaluation of exact phishing/BEC/lookalike/QR/redirect and email-auth signals without any response authority. Comprehensive input validation revalidates immutable untrusted observations, including tenant isolation and authority boundaries. Confidence is deterministic and rule-based, with source-specific auth handling enforced. Evidence is recorded before a finding is returned; audit failure denies the finding. All 21 tests pass with parametrized boundary coverage. No operations affect browser state, mailbox, message movement, links, accounts, network, credentials, filesystem, or deployment.
